definition: (PROBE — rejected as sized; keeper UNCHANGED.) caiso-119 single delta on the 2026-07-23-caiso-netrev-margin-keeper recipe: caiso_ra_min_load_frac 0.26 -> 0.570, the MEASURED physical min-stable-load of a fully-online CAISO CC (CEMS per-unit p05 of grossLoad/pmax over opTime==1.0 hours, cap-weighted p50 = 0.565/0.570/0.570 across 2023-25; ERCOT's independent 60-Day-DAM analogue is 0.574). Never tuned back toward 0.26 (rules 13/18/25). Control arm caiso119_base_A (same-HEAD replay, no delta) is not registered — a container restart cost it its meta.json.
